    Uniqueness of Auslander–Reiten sequences #

    Right almost split maps stay right almost split after an isomorphism of the target (isRightAS_comp_iso). Two exact sequences 0 → K → E → Z → 0 and 0 → K → E' → Z' → 0 with injective left almost split first maps and local End Z, End Z' have isomorphic end terms (coker_iso_of_leftAS).
